rationale: Confident, gloating victory lap voice with swagger and no hedging; correctly anchors the collapse (Gorbachev/Yeltsin/republics declaring independence) and invokes the Berlin Wall and Soviet space failures. The tone fully embraces ‘they can’t respond’ bragging.
quote: The Berlin Wall wasn’t just a physical barrier; it was a dam holding back a tidal wave of Levi’s and Michael Jackson cassettes.
